name: Project Athanasia
source:
Play as Lettie, a young woman who finds herself kidnapped by members of an elite organization dedicated to creating an immortality serum. Despite being kidnapped, you find yourself drawn into the stories and lives of each member. What will you do? The choices you make determine how the story plays out.

[From [url=https://lettielet.itch.io/project-athanasia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演莱蒂，一名年轻女子，发现自己被一个致力于制造永生血清的精英组织的成员绑架。尽管被绑架，你还是发现自己被每个成员的故事和生活所吸引。你会怎么做？你所做的选择决定了故事的发展。

[来自[url=https://lettielet.itch.io/project-athanasia]itch.io[/url]]
